methods.name: getNumberOfComponents

methods.name: toRGBInt
methods.doc:
Converts CMYK components [0..1] to a packed ARGB int using the standard multiplicative ("no ICC profile") formula 
   R = (1 - C) * (1 - K) * 255
   G = (1 - M) * (1 - K) * 255
   B = (1 - Y) * (1 - K) * 255
This preserves the algebraic primaries — pure C maps to {@code (0,255,255)}, pure K to {@code (0,0,0)}, registration black {@code (1,1,1,1)} to black, white {@code (0,0,0,0)} to white — which is what the public API contract assumes (see {@code ColorSpaceTest.testDeviceCMYKToInt} and {@code AsposeColorActionPortedTest.createDeviceCMYK}), and matches both {@code ColorConverter.cmykToRgb} and PDFBox's non-ICC mapping.
